data.name: Gym Beginner Full Body
data.description: Three identical full-body sessions a week with a rest day between them. A good first program if you are new to the gym.

workout_templates.name: Beginner Full Body
workout_templates.description: Eight exercises that cover every major muscle group, mostly on machines. Choose a weight that lets you finish every set with two repetitions to spare.
